answer: Slash-coupled vouching is a sybil brake: weight moves only when a delegator stakes its own standing behind a delegate, so unmasking one clone cuts weight out of every agent above it on the vouching ledge. At dawn each epoch the graph re-signs, and a self-vouching clone ring collapses into one bounded loss domain capped by its richest member's stake — a farm must bond every link with real slashable stake, so each sable head it appends deepens its own shared fall.
